audience: HR and payroll teams that check employee time punches in a TimeTrex installation

useCases.title: Review the branches and departments
useCases.text: List the branches, which are the work sites, and the departments of the installation to see how the company is set up.

useCases.title: Check one employee's punches for a pay period
useCases.text: Find the employee by name or employee number. Then list that employee's clock in and clock out records between two dates.

useCases.title: List the employees and their record ids
useCases.text: List the employees with their employee number and name. Filter by number or name, and use the record id in other tools.
